name: Coca-Cola
description: Coca-Cola mostly sells concentrate, syrup and brand rights to independent bottling partners who mix, package and distribute the drinks, which keeps capital needs low and margins high (2025 operating margin 28.7%, comparable margin 31.2%). It keeps a smaller business of company-owned bottlers (Bottling Investments, about $5.7B of segment revenue at a 7% margin) and owns finished-goods brands such as Fairlife, Costa, innocent and BODYARMOR. Growth comes from price and mix (+4% in 2025) with flat unit-case volume. 2025 had a $6.1B contingent payment for Fairlife and a $960M non-cash BODYARMOR trademark impairment.

employees.note: About 65,900 (69,700 a year earlier), about 8,900 in the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Europe, Middle East and Africa
businessLines.how: Sells concentrate and syrup to bottling partners who make and distribute; also company-owned Costa, innocent and dogadan results since 2025.

businessLines.name: Latin America
businessLines.how: Concentrate sales to bottlers; very high margin because bottling is done by partners.

businessLines.name: North America
businessLines.how: Concentrate plus finished products in the US and Canada (including Fairlife, Costa RTD, BODYARMOR, Topo Chico) sold through the system and directly.

businessLines.name: Asia Pacific
businessLines.how: Concentrate sales to bottlers across Asia Pacific.

businessLines.name: Bottling Investments
businessLines.how: Company-owned bottlers that make and deliver finished drinks to stores; low margin, high revenue per dollar of concentrate.

brands.name: Fairlife
brands.note: US dairy; $6.1B contingent consideration paid Q1 2025

brands.name: Costa, innocent, dogadan
brands.note: Moved from Global Ventures into EMEA effective 2025-01-01
